name: design-review
description: Review frontend design contracts, visual alignment, accessibility, component usage, and design debt with Qoder skills and a DESIGN.md Canvas viewer.

interface.shortDescription: Review frontend design contracts and UI implementation quality
interface.longDescription: Use Design to inspect DESIGN.md contracts, compare UI implementation with design references, review accessibility and component-library alignment, detect design debt, and capture design-system evidence. The plugin also previews DESIGN.md files as Canvas design-system summaries.
defaultPrompt: Run Design QA for this frontend screen
Check this UI for design debt
Implement responsive layout for this component
Design a UI prototype for this page
